title: The Church Bells
text: What varying sounds from yon grey pinnacles Sweep o'er the ear, and claim the heart's reply ! Now the blithe peal of home festivity, Natal or nuptial, in full concert swells: Now the brisk chime, or voice of alter'd bells, Speaks the due hour of social worship nigh: And now the last stage of mortality The deep dull toll with lingering warning tells. How much of human life those sounds comprise; Birth, wedded love, God's service, and the tomb! Heard not in vain, if thence kind feelings rise, Such as befit our being, free from gloom Monastick, pray'r that communes with the skies, And musings mindful of the final doom.
